items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Willie Cook said that Jay McShann was real upset with what Earl did to him in Boston.

ctx.x: Yeah. And everytime they came down, they stole another one out of Texas, musicians, or Oklahoma musicians, you know. That's how they got Lips, and guys from Oklahoma. In fact, I can say this, Earl Hines was most famous for stealing members out of the band. I think McShann put it mildly when he said that Earl Hines came to him and offered him some money, you know.
Well, I think so, too, because somebody told Hines -- I think in the book I did on Ellington, Willie Cook said that Jay McShann was real upset with what Earl did to him in Boston.
